NEW cycle 5 (Codex-confirmed REAL — DISAGREEMENT: Codex HIGH vs workflow-verifier MEDIUM-on-dormancy; BOTH kept for Mason). Voiding ONE invoice of a grouped (multi-customer) blend ticket resets the WHOLE ticket to 'unbilled' -> re-billable -> DOUBLE-BILLING. create_invoice_from_blend_ticket, when v_customer_count>1, assigns a shared invoice_group_id and inserts MULTIPLE invoices all carrying the same blend_ticket_id, then sets blend_tickets.payment_status='billed' ONCE; its only re-bill guard is IF v_ticket.payment_status='billed' THEN RAISE 'already billed'. The trigger trg_sync_blend_ticket_payment (AFTER UPDATE ON invoices WHEN status distinct) -> sync_blend_ticket_payment_status does, when one invoice goes voided/cancelled, an UNCONDITIONAL UPDATE blend_tickets SET payment_status='unbilled' WHERE id=NEW.blend_ticket_id AND payment_status='billed' with NO check for OTHER surviving non-voided invoices. So voiding one invoice of a grouped ticket flips the ENTIRE ticket back to 'unbilled' while siblings stay posted -> create_invoice_from_blend_ticket generates a SECOND full set of invoices = double-billing every customer on the ticket. Distinct from cycle-1 blend:create_invoice_from_blend_ticket:prepaid-rebill-gap (that was the manual prepaid/no_charge bypass). Dormant (0 blend tickets / 0 blend invoices / 0 grouped / 0 billed live) -> latent but reachable the moment the first multi-customer blend ticket is billed. FIX: guard the reset with NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices WHERE blend_ticket_id=NEW.blend_ticket_id AND status NOT IN ('voided','cancelled')) — only reset to 'unbilled' when NO live invoices remain. Evidence: 20260335100000_workflow_gaps_phase2_blend_ticket_invoice.sql ~L196-202 (sync fn, no NOT EXISTS guard); 20260616191740...sql:99/168 (grouped create). Migration.

No .rpc('update_allocation_set') caller in src (only generated types + a fixture test).
